answer: The cheapest real defence: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because canyon only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, onyx is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any haven approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
